title: StepPatch
description: A proposed change to exactly one step of a workflow. Produced by the healer, reviewed by a person, and applied to the IR. A patch names the workflow version it was written against, so it cannot be applied to a workflow that has changed since.

workflowId.description: Id of the workflow this patch applies to.

baseHash.description: Hash of the workflow the patch was written against, as returned by hashWorkflow. Applying the patch to a workflow with a different hash is refused.

stepId.description: The step the patch is anchored to. For 'replace' it is the step being replaced. For the insert operations it is the existing step the new one goes next to.

op.description: What the patch does. 'replace' swaps the anchored step for 'after', keeping its id. 'insert_before' and 'insert_after' add 'after' as a new sibling of the anchored step.

before.description: The anchored step as it was when the patch was written. Required for 'replace', where it must equal the step currently in the workflow.

after.description: The new step. For 'replace' it carries the same id as the step it replaces. For the insert operations it carries an id not used anywhere else in the workflow.

rationale.description: Why the change is proposed, in plain language for the person reviewing it.

confidence.description: How confident the author is that the patch is correct, from 0 to 1.
